name: save_facts
description: Save new facts the user has just told you, so they are never asked again. Call this as soon as the user confirms something new about themselves (for example a child's age, who lives with them, whether a child is in full-time education, a change in work or rent). Do not save guesses, only what the user actually said.

request_body_schema.description: The new facts to merge into the user's profile.

facts.description: The new facts. Fill only the fields the user just told you; leave the rest out.

children_living_with_user.description: How many children live with the user most of the time.

all_children_under_18.description: True if the user confirmed every child is under 18.

children_ages.description: Ages of the children, comma separated, e.g. '15, 9, 4'.

eldest_in_approved_education.description: True if a child aged 16 to 19 is in full-time non-advanced education or approved training (school, college, A levels, T levels, NVQ level 3 or below).

employment_status.description: e.g. 'employed full time', 'part time', 'self-employed', 'not working', 'unable to work'.

housing.description: e.g. 'private renting', 'council or housing association', 'own with mortgage', 'living with family'.

monthly_rent_pounds.description: Monthly rent in pounds, if they told you.

has_disability_or_health_condition.description: True if the user or someone in the household has a disability or long-term health condition.

is_carer.description: True if the user cares for someone at least 35 hours a week.

subscription_wanted.description: Whether the user says they meant to sign up to the flagged subscription.

other.description: Any other new fact, written as 'key: value; key: value', e.g. 'partner_lives_with_user: yes'.
